stem: According to information in “Building a Better Sandcastle,” a tall sandcastle tower might fall if —

options.label: F
options.text: its base is too small to support it

options.label: G
options.text: it is not built by an expert sculptor

options.label: H
options.text: too many details are carved into the sandcastle

options.label: J
options.text: tools are not used when building the sandcastle
